roadmap.title: Early Udûn: Black Gate to Durthang
roadmap.description: Re-forge the first towers, collect runes and artifacts, buy rune slots, start each weapon's legend missions and clear the early challenges.

roadmap.title: Udûn story and Warchiefs
roadmap.description: Follow Golem's visions, free Ratbag, poison the Warchiefs' feasts and bring down Mogg, the Monument Gate and the Hammer.

roadmap.title: Núrnen story and sweep
roadmap.description: Cross to the Sea of Núrnen, learn Brand, banish the White Wizard, then sweep its towers, collectibles, legend missions and rescues.

roadmap.title: Torvin and the beasts
roadmap.description: Meet Torvin, tame beasts, kill the Great White Graug and finish the Hunting Challenges and the Caragor ride.

roadmap.title: Warchief feats and the endgame
roadmap.description: Use your Branded army for the captain feats, then Brand the Núrnen Warchiefs, kill the Tower and the Black Hand.

roadmap.title: The Bright Lord campaign
roadmap.description: Play Celebrimbor's campaign: Shadow Brand, the Udûn towers, the One Ring missions and the fight with Sauron.

roadmap.title: Test of the Ring
roadmap.description: Win the 60-minute trial and earn a Level 30 Rune in this mode.

roadmap.title: Lord of the Hunt campaign
roadmap.description: Hunt with Torvin: Caragaths, Wretched Graugs, Ghûl Matrons and the five Beastmaster Warchiefs.

roadmap.title: Test of the Wild
roadmap.description: The 40-minute trial with Beast kills, 20 captains, five Warchiefs and 13,000 points.

achievements.description: Collect 25% of the Artifacts.
achievements.summary: Collect 11 of the 42 Artifacts and activate their Memory Points.

guide.context: Any 11 count; these are the 11 nearest the start. An Artifact counts once its Memory Point is activated. Skipping the memory playback is fine; only the activation matters.

collectibles.name: Branding Iron

collectibles.name: Tattered Note

collectibles.name: Serpentine Blade
collectibles.location: Far west of the region, deep inside a cave
collectibles.method: Switch to Wraith World, collect the artifact, then rotate it and activate its Memory Point at this spot: pommel.

collectibles.name: Coded Journal Entry #1
collectibles.method: Switch to Wraith World, collect the artifact, then rotate it and activate its Memory Point at this spot: the dead crow, on its back at the neck.

collectibles.name: Grog Bowl
collectibles.method: Switch to Wraith World, collect the artifact, then rotate it and activate its Memory Point at this spot: bottom of the left-most bowl handle.

collectibles.name: Graven Idol Representing Morgoth

achievements.description: Brand 5 Bodyguards of a Warchief, turning them against him in combat.
achievements.summary: Brand five bodyguards of one Warchief, then command them to fight against him.

guide.context: Complete any open Uruk Missions of your Branded bodyguards first; a bodyguard with a pending mission stays away when the Warchief comes out.

steps.text: Choose a Warchief and Brand any bodyguards he already has.
Dominate your Branded captains and Command them to Initiate into his service, finishing each Uruk Mission.
Once five Branded bodyguards serve him, lure him out.
Command the Branded bodyguards to attack the Warchief.

achievements.description: Complete all Azkâr Legend Missions.
achievements.summary: Complete all 10 Azkâr bow Legend Missions.

guide.context: Five missions are in Udûn and five in the Sea of Núrnen. The Spirit of Fire only opens after you buy the Tier 3 Fire Arrow ability.

collectibles.name: A Elbereth Githoniel
collectibles.method: Kill all the incoming Uruk Archers.

collectibles.name: Swift Mercy
collectibles.method: Kill 15 weakened Uruks within 30 seconds. The timer starts at your first kill, and Focus slows it.

collectibles.name: Shadow Under Siege
collectibles.method: Kill 10 marked Uruks without entering Durthang Stronghold.
collectibles.note: Kills by baited or freed Caragors count.

collectibles.name: The Storm of War
collectibles.method: Mount the Caragor and chase three scout patrols, shooting 4, then 4, then 2 Uruk Archers.
collectibles.note: Drain your Caragor to refill arrows, but watch its health.

collectibles.name: The Eye of Vengeance
collectibles.method: Kill 5 Uruks at close range with the bow. Use Focus and headshots.

collectibles.name: Shadow & Flame
collectibles.method: Kill 30 Uruks by shooting Grog Barrels to detonate them.
collectibles.note: Uruks are endless but the barrels are limited.

collectibles.name: There Is No Escape
collectibles.method: Stop all 5 runaway Uruks before they get to Fort Morn. Run ahead of them and take headshots in Focus.

collectibles.name: The Secret Flame
collectibles.method: Lure Ghûls into the Barrows at the back of the cave and kill 50 by detonating Grog Barrels.
collectibles.note: Let a fresh group of Ghûls walk in before you set off the next barrel.

collectibles.name: The Spirit of Fire
collectibles.method: Kill any 5 Uruks with Fire Arrows.
collectibles.note: Needs the Tier 3 Fire Arrow ability.

collectibles.name: Jaws of Steel
collectibles.method: Snipe 10 marked Uruks from the top of the Stronghold gate without leaving it.
collectibles.note: More than 10 are marked, and Caragors can also make kills.

achievements.description: Complete a Bow Mission and begin growing the legend of Azkâr.
achievements.summary: Complete one Azkâr bow Legend Mission.

steps.text: At the south end of the @loc{Black Road}, start the Legend Mission A Elbereth Githoniel.
Kill all the incoming Uruk Archers.

achievements.description: Bring down the Monument Gate and the statue of Sauron.
achievements.summary: Blow up the Monument Gate and bring down the Sauron statue in the story mission The Dark Monument.

steps.text: Help Hirgon steal a cart of Grog Barrels and protect it.
Make sure the Outcasts reach the Sauron statue at the Monument Gate.
Detonate the barrels so the gate falls and the statue topples.

achievements.description: Complete all Acharn Legend Missions.
achievements.summary: Complete all 10 Acharn dagger Legend Missions.

guide.context: Five missions are in Udûn and five in the Sea of Núrnen. Learning Brand opens the rest. Display of Power needs the Tier 2 Brutalize ability.

collectibles.name: The Mithril Blade
collectibles.method: Stealth kill 10 Uruks within 3:00. Staying undetected is only a bonus.

collectibles.name: Clear the Skies
collectibles.method: Stealth kill 10 Uruk Archers while keeping the Alarm quiet.
collectibles.note: You may be detected.

collectibles.name: The Wraith
collectibles.method: Stealth kill 5 Uruks of your choice while staying unseen.

collectibles.name: Deathly Whisper
collectibles.method: Use Attract to lure Uruks over and kill 5 of them while they investigate.
collectibles.note: You may be detected.

collectibles.name: Display of Power
collectibles.method: Sneak through the camp into Uruk's Hollow undetected and Stealth Brutalize the marked Uruk.
collectibles.note: Needs the Tier 2 Brutalize ability.

collectibles.name: A Knife In the Dark
collectibles.method: Kill every marked Uruk, by any means, without being detected.

collectibles.name: The Darkness Within
collectibles.method: Reach the marked spot undetected, then Stealth Brand all 7 marked Uruk Archers undetected. Afterwards kill the arriving patrol with your Branded Uruks.
collectibles.note: Being detected before the 7 are Branded restarts the mission. Attract some archers toward ledges to reach them.

collectibles.name: Shadow & Steel
collectibles.method: Stealth kill 5 marked Uruk Defenders without the Alarm being raised.
collectibles.note: You may be detected.

collectibles.name: Fatal Secrets
collectibles.method: Follow an Uruk Messenger undetected, kill each Worm he talks to before it runs, then kill him, all within 8:00.
collectibles.note: Headshots work best, and Shadow Strike helps you get ahead of him.

collectibles.name: The Scouring of Shadow
collectibles.method: Visit every site and stealthily kill all the Uruk Torchbearers without being detected.

achievements.description: Complete a Dagger Mission and begin growing the legend of Acharn.
achievements.summary: Complete one Acharn dagger Legend Mission.

steps.text: At the southwest edge of the @loc{Black Gate}, start the Legend Mission The Mithril Blade.
Stealth kill 10 Uruks within 3:00. Staying undetected is only a bonus.

achievements.description: Use Strike From Above while at least 60 feet above your target.
achievements.summary: Use Strike From Above on an Uruk from at least 60 feet up.

guide.context: Strike From Above is a Tier 1 Ranger ability you must buy first.

steps.text: Climb to the top of a Forge Tower, which is well above 60 feet.
Wait until an Uruk walks below, or lure some over.
Crouch and use a stealth kill to leap down onto the Uruk.
steps.note: If you are detected while up there, the leap only knocks the Uruk down.

achievements.description: Make an uruk yours.
achievements.summary: Interrogate an Uruk for Intel for the first time, during the tutorial in Udûn.

steps.text: Re-forge the first Forge Tower in @loc{Udûn Foothills}, then drop down and defeat the Uruks that attack.
Follow the interrogation tutorial and get Intel from the Uruk.

achievements.description: Poison a Captain at his own Feast.
achievements.summary: Poison a Grog Barrel at an Uruk captain's Feast so that the captain drinks from it.

guide.context: You learn Poison in the story mission The Outcasts.

steps.text: Use Advance Time at a Forge Tower, repeating as needed, until the map shows a Feast mission.
Sneak in without being seen and poison a Grog Barrel.
Stay hidden until the captain drinks from it.

achievements.description: Activate all Forge Towers.
achievements.summary: Re-forge all 12 Forge Towers in Udûn and the Sea of Núrnen.

guide.context: Each Forge Tower you re-forge also shows the herbs, runes, Artifacts and missions of the regions around it.

collectibles.name: Udûn Foothills tower
collectibles.method: Re-forge it as part of the story at the start.

collectibles.name: Black Road tower

collectibles.method: Re-forge it.

achievements.description: Uncover a first glimpse of the Wraith's past.
achievements.summary: Witness the first vision of the Wraith's past in the story mission An Interested Party.

steps.text: In Wraith World, follow Golem's tracks from the @loc{Black Gate} to the cave in the @loc{Black Road} region.
Pick up the vision and watch it, then kill the Caragor that attacks.

achievements.description: Start a Riot by commanding a Warchief to attack another Warchief.
achievements.summary: Start a riot by ordering a Branded Warchief you control to attack a second Warchief.

guide.context: A Branded Warchief shows as a blue skull on the map.

steps.text: Brand a Warchief.
Grab and Dominate him.
Command him to attack a second Warchief.

achievements.description: Successfully complete a Survivalist Challenge.
achievements.summary: Complete one Survival Challenge.

guide.context: Herbs respawn when you Fast Travel or Advance Time at a Forge Tower.

steps.text: In @loc{Udûn Foothills}, collect 2 Niphredil, the white flowers that show on the mini-map.
Open the Survival Challenge screen to confirm it is done.

achievements.description: Successfully complete 4 Hunting Challenges.
achievements.summary: Complete 4 Hunting Challenges.

guide.context: The first four challenges are open from the start.

steps.text: Kill 3 Ungol Spiders around the @loc{Udûn Foothills} Forge Tower.
Kill 5 flying creatures; Morgul Bats roost over the northeast @loc{Black Road} cave by day.
Kill 3 Caragors, which are plentiful in @loc{Durthang}.
Kill 4 Mordor Rats around the @loc{Black Gate} and Strongholds.

achievements.description: Liberate 30 slaves in 180 seconds while riding a caragor.
achievements.summary: Free 30 slaves within 180 seconds while riding a Caragor.

guide.context: A slave counts when it starts to run, so you do not have to kill the guarding Uruks. The timer starts at the first slave you free, and you may swap Caragors.

steps.text: Play in daytime, when more slaves appear, in the Sea of Núrnen.
Mount a Caragor at @loc{Tirith Mesas}.
Ride the loop: @loc{Celon Poros}, through the pass to @loc{Cape of Nurn}, east to @loc{Watcher's Landing}, back to @loc{Celon Poros}.
Ride through the Uruks guarding each slave group until 30 have run off.
Fast Travel to another Forge Tower if an area has no slaves.

achievements.description: Save Lithariel from the Stronghold.
achievements.summary: Rescue Lithariel in the story mission The Rescue.

guide.context: First finish the mission The Cure: three marked areas at @loc{Fort Morn} must be cleared quietly, with no Alarm. One of them has a captain who cannot be Dominated.

steps.text: Infiltrate the @loc{Núrnen Peninsula} Stronghold and Brand at least 6 Uruks within 8:00 without raising the Alarm.
Find and rescue Lithariel.
Escort the injured Lithariel out of the Stronghold and fend off the Uruks that follow.

achievements.description: Eliminate the bodyguards of two Warchiefs, then draw them out and kill them.
achievements.summary: Wipe out the bodyguards of two different Warchiefs, then lure out and kill each of those Warchiefs.

guide.context: Both Warchiefs must have bodyguards.

steps.text: Get Intel on the Warchiefs to see who guards them, and choose one with a single bodyguard.
Kill all of his bodyguards, then enter his Warchief Mission and kill him.
Repeat with a second Warchief.

achievements.description: Witness how the Rings of Power were made.
achievements.summary: See how the Rings of Power were forged, in the story mission The One Truth.

steps.text: Track Golem through Wraith World into the big cave system on the western side of @loc{Barrows of Udûn} and find the Vision Artifact at its far end.
When the vision ends, run from the Graug and Shadow Strike the Ghûl on the far side of the cave.

achievements.description: Brand a Captain while in combat.
achievements.summary: Brand an Uruk captain with a Combat Brand while in combat with him.

guide.context: You need the Brand ability from the story mission Queen of the Shore. Grabbing and Dominating a captain does not count.

steps.text: Pick a captain that is vulnerable or only damaged by Combat Finishers. An invulnerable one cannot be used.
If he is vulnerable, use a Combat Brand to convert him at once.
If he is only damaged by them, wear his health down to about 10% first, then use the Combat Brand.
Good hunting ground: the many captains inside the @loc{Maw of Hope}.

achievements.description: Complete all Survivalist Challenges.
achievements.summary: Complete all 10 Survival Challenges.

guide.context: Each region on the map screen lists its herbs. Mushrooms are usually inside caves or under bridges. Herbs respawn when you Fast Travel or Advance Time at a Forge Tower. Later challenges are not available until you get to the Sea of Núrnen.

collectibles.name: Challenge 1
collectibles.method: Collect 2 Niphredil (white flowers).

collectibles.name: Challenge 2
collectibles.method: Collect 3 Pipeweed (green flowers) and the Lothrond (yellow mushroom) the challenge asks for.
collectibles.note: The Lothrond is at the Black Gate.

collectibles.name: Challenge 3
collectibles.method: Collect 2 Remmenthond (red roots) and 2 Azuradan (blue roots).
collectibles.note: Azuradan grows at the Black Gate.

collectibles.name: Challenge 4
collectibles.method: Collect 2 Niphredil, 2 Lothrond (yellow mushrooms) and 1 Azuradan (blue root).

collectibles.name: Challenge 5
collectibles.method: Collect 4 Blue Milk (blue mushrooms) and 2 Mallos (yellow roots).
collectibles.note: Blue Milk grows under the bridges in the Foothills.

collectibles.name: Challenge 6
collectibles.method: Collect 3 Elgaran (red flowers) and 3 Earthbread (green roots).

collectibles.name: Challenge 7
collectibles.method: Collect the Gwînuial (white roots) and Alfirin (yellow flowers) the challenge asks for.

collectibles.name: Challenge 8
collectibles.method: Collect 2 Naugrimbas (white mushrooms), 3 Carandôl (red mushrooms) and 2 Orchamarth (green mushrooms).

collectibles.name: Challenge 9
collectibles.location: Almost every region of the @loc{Sea of Núrnen}
collectibles.method: Collect 7 Athelas (blue flowers).

collectibles.name: Challenge 10
collectibles.method: Collect 3 Blue Milk (blue mushrooms), the Elgaran (red flowers) the challenge asks for, and 2 Gwînuial (white roots).

achievements.description: Complete all Hunting Challenges.
achievements.summary: Complete all 10 Hunting Challenges.

guide.context: Challenges 5 and later only start after main missions, so you cannot finish the list at the start. The last three are the hard ones.

collectibles.name: Challenge 1: Ungol Spiders
collectibles.method: Kill 3 Ungol Spiders with the bow or by running them over.

collectibles.name: Challenge 2: flying creatures
collectibles.location: Cave at the northeast end of the @loc{Black Road}
collectibles.method: Kill 5 flying creatures. Morgul Bats roost over the cave in daytime; Hell Hawks also count.

collectibles.name: Challenge 3: Caragors
collectibles.method: Kill 3 Caragors. Durthang has many in cages or lured by bait.

collectibles.name: Challenge 4: Mordor Rats
collectibles.method: Kill 4 Mordor Rats, best with the bow.

collectibles.name: Challenge 5: Ghûls
collectibles.location: Starts after the Shattered Memories vision
collectibles.method: Kill 8 Ghûls when they attack after the vision.

collectibles.name: Challenge 6: Bats
collectibles.location: Cave at the northeast end of the @loc{Black Road}
collectibles.method: Kill 3 Bats, which roost at the entrance or fly around it at night.

collectibles.name: Challenge 7: Graug
collectibles.location: Caves around @loc{Barrows of Udûn} and the Black Road
collectibles.method: Kill a Graug. Headshot it to stagger it and hit it with the sword, then repeat. The story mission Hunting Partners also ends with one.

collectibles.name: Challenge 8: Dire Caragor
collectibles.location: Sea of Núrnen, after the mission Hunting Partners
collectibles.method: Kill a Dire Caragor. Start Torvin's mission The Great White Graug, mount the Dire Caragor you tame, use Kill Mount, then abandon the mission.
collectibles.note: Otherwise begin at the Tirith Mesas or Cape of Nurn tower, hurry to the cave in northern @loc{Celon Poros}, and look for a red-outlined Caragor in Wraith World. Fast Travel away and back to respawn it.

collectibles.name: Challenge 9: Ghûl Matron
collectibles.location: Udûn Crossing cave, or any open area at night
collectibles.method: Kill a Ghûl Matron. The Urfael mission Nameless Things guarantees one after you clear the three Ghûl nests, so save that mission for this.
collectibles.note: Otherwise at night kill Ghûls until a few flee, let them go, and repeat until a Matron appears.

collectibles.name: Challenge 10: Horned Graug
collectibles.location: Cave at the north end of @loc{Celon Poros}
collectibles.method: Kill a Horned Graug. The Great White Graug counts. Otherwise Shadow Mount a Horned Graug at the cave and use Kill Mount.
collectibles.note: Horned Graugs are rare there, so keep Fast Travelling between those towers and the cave.

achievements.description: Complete an Outcast Rescue Mission.
achievements.summary: Complete one Outcast Rescue Mission.

guide.context: These start after the story mission The Slaver.

steps.text: Finish The Slaver at the @loc{Black Gate}.
Free a marked Outcast, then start any Outcast Rescue Mission, such as The Fallen in @loc{Barrows of Udûn}, and rescue the 3 slaves.

achievements.description: Complete all Outcast Rescue Missions.
achievements.summary: Complete all 24 Outcast Rescue Missions.

guide.context: Free a marked Outcast (a fist icon on the map) to open a mission. Fast Travel back to a Forge Tower to free the same Outcast again and open the rest. Missions open in waves, so finish the earlier ones to unlock later ones.

collectibles.name: The Fallen
collectibles.method: Rescue 3 slaves.

collectibles.name: Hold Your Tongue
collectibles.method: Rescue 3 slaves.

collectibles.name: Shattered
collectibles.method: Rescue 3 slaves.

collectibles.name: Resistance
collectibles.method: Rescue 3 slaves.

collectibles.name: Unleashed
collectibles.method: Rescue 3 slaves.

collectibles.name: Worked to Death
collectibles.method: Rescue 3 slaves.

collectibles.name: Over the Edge
collectibles.method: Rescue 3 slaves.
collectibles.note: Locked until you buy the Brutalize ability.

collectibles.name: Drink Up
collectibles.method: Rescue 3 slaves.
collectibles.note: Needs the Poison ability.

collectibles.name: Venom
collectibles.method: Rescue 5 slaves.

collectibles.name: Borrowed Blades
collectibles.method: Rescue 5 slaves.

collectibles.name: The Watcher
collectibles.method: Rescue 5 slaves.

collectibles.name: The Uprising
collectibles.method: Rescue 7 slaves.
collectibles.note: Appears only after every earlier Udûn mission is done.

collectibles.name: The Name of Power
collectibles.method: Rescue 3 slaves.

collectibles.name: The Evil Eye
collectibles.method: Rescue 3 slaves.

collectibles.name: The Hunger
collectibles.method: Rescue 3 slaves.

collectibles.name: Unchained
collectibles.method: Rescue 3 slaves.

collectibles.name: The Stand
collectibles.method: Rescue 3 slaves.

collectibles.name: Unbroken
collectibles.method: Rescue 3 slaves.

collectibles.name: In the Flesh
collectibles.method: Rescue 5 slaves within 2:00 each; the timer resets after every rescue.
collectibles.note: A Caragor helps with distance, or use Elven Swiftness and Shadow Strike.

collectibles.name: Last Hope
collectibles.method: Rescue 3 slaves.

collectibles.name: Nowhere to Hide
collectibles.method: Rescue 5 slaves.

collectibles.name: Weapons of War
collectibles.method: Rescue 5 slaves.

collectibles.name: Light In the Darkness
collectibles.method: Rescue 10 slaves while fighting an endless horde of Uruks.
collectibles.note: Freed slaves fight and can free others.

collectibles.name: To Freedom
collectibles.method: Rescue 5 slaves.
collectibles.note: Appears only after every other Outcast Rescue Mission is done.

achievements.description: Complete a Vendetta Mission.
achievements.summary: Kill the Revenge Target who killed you.

guide.context: Vendetta Missions no longer exist; killing your Revenge Target counts instead.

steps.text: Let any Uruk or captain kill you. He gets a red Revenge Target marker.
Find that Uruk and kill him.

achievements.description: Help Ratbag rise to Warchief.
achievements.summary: Get Ratbag promoted to Warchief by killing Mogg the Other Twin.

guide.context: Complete this after the other four Udûn Warchiefs, or the Power Vacuum goal is harder.

steps.text: Start the story mission The Warchief at the @loc{East Garrison} and meet Ratbag.
Defeat Mogg's two Uruk Berserker trainees so Mogg appears.
Kill Mogg, and Ratbag becomes a Warchief.

achievements.description: Help a Captain survive a Recruitment Power Struggle, and then kill him and all his new recruits.
achievements.summary: Get a captain through a Recruitment Power Struggle alive, then kill both him and every recruit he gained.

guide.context: Dispatch (Tier 5) helps but is not needed.

steps.text: Advance Time until one of your Branded captains has a Recruitment mission on the map.
Help him survive it, shooting attackers from hiding.
Kill every one of his new recruits first, using Focus headshots.
Kill the captain last.

achievements.description: Complete all Urfael Legend Missions.
achievements.summary: Complete all 10 Urfael sword Legend Missions.

guide.context: Five missions are in Udûn and five in the Sea of Núrnen. Some only open after an ability purchase: Arise needs Combat Drain (Tier 3), Nameless Things needs Wraith Flash, and Power of the One needs Dispatch (Tier 5).

collectibles.name: Into the Pit
collectibles.method: Defeat 50 Uruks in the arena. The Combat Finisher ability makes this much easier.

collectibles.name: The Fell Beast
collectibles.method: Mount the Caragor and kill the fleeing Uruks within 3:00, before they return to their Strongholds.
collectibles.note: Headshot them and do not waste arrows or Focus on others.

collectibles.name: Cutting the Lines
collectibles.method: Enter the training grounds and kill every marked Uruk Trainee.

collectibles.name: Arise
collectibles.method: Defeat 40 Uruks.
collectibles.note: Needs the Tier 3 Combat Drain ability. The campfire and Grog Barrels nearby can burn many of them.

collectibles.name: Nameless Things
collectibles.method: Clear the three Ghûl nests inside the cave, then kill the Ghûl Matron that spawns.
collectibles.note: Needs Wraith Flash. Save it until you need a Ghûl Matron for the Hunting Challenge.

collectibles.name: Bane of Shadow
collectibles.method: Kill the three marked Elite Guards by any means.

collectibles.name: They Shall Not Pass
collectibles.method: Hold out for 4:00 against endless Uruks without letting any Torchbearer past. Brand Uruks to help defend.

collectibles.name: The Red Tide
collectibles.method: Clear every Uruk from 5 locations along the docks, then leave the Fishery.

collectibles.name: The Dark Rider
collectibles.method: Mount the Caragor and ride to the three execution spots to free the slaves.
collectibles.note: Keep the Caragor healthy by eating Uruks with its bite.

collectibles.name: Power of the One
collectibles.method: Brand Uruks and let them kill at least 10 enemies, then kill every Uruk you Branded yourself.
collectibles.note: Do not use Dispatch, because it also kills your Branded captains nearby. Needs the Tier 5 Dispatch ability.

achievements.description: Complete a Sword Mission and begin growing the legend of Urfael.
achievements.summary: Complete one Urfael sword Legend Mission.

steps.text: At the @loc{Uruk Proving Grounds}, near the arena, start the Legend Mission Into the Pit.
Defeat 50 Uruks in the arena. The Combat Finisher ability makes this easier.

achievements.description: Free Queen Marwen from the curse.
achievements.summary: Lift Queen Marwen's curse in the story mission The Power of the Wraith.

guide.context: Reach the Sea of Núrnen with the story mission The Messenger and learn Brand in Queen of the Shore first.

steps.text: Hunt down Grûblik the Flogger. Weaken and grab him, then Dominate him.
Command him to Initiate as a bodyguard of the Warchief Târz the Knife and finish the Uruk Mission this creates.
Get to the lookout spot in the @loc{Maw of Hope} without setting off any Stronghold alarm; Târz then shows up.
Command Grûblik to attack Târz and help kill him.
Return to Queen Marwen to lift her curse.

achievements.description: Slay the Black Hand.
achievements.summary: Kill the Black Hand in the story mission Mordor In Flames.

steps.text: Start the mission and return to the @loc{Black Gate} in Udûn with 5 Branded captains and Warchiefs.
Defeat the 5 Talons of the Hand.
Climb the Black Gate and kill the Black Hand.

achievements.description: Slay the Great White Graug.
achievements.summary: Kill the Great White Graug in the story mission of that name.

steps.text: Join Torvin at @loc{Celon Poros}, tame the Dire Caragor, and ride together to the Graug's den in the @loc{Núrnen Wilderness}.
Bait the Graug into charging, then headshot it mid-charge so it hits the cave wall.
While it is stunned, use a mounted attack on it, then kill the Ghûls that appear before it eats them and heals.
Repeat the stun-and-attack cycle at least three times.

achievements.description: After an uruk kills you to become a Captain, help him become a Warchief, then kill him.
achievements.summary: Let an Uruk kill you to become a captain, boost him up to Warchief, then kill him.

guide.context: This is easier in Udûn, because your Branded Warchiefs in the Sea of Núrnen cannot be chosen.

steps.text: Let an ordinary Uruk kill you so he becomes a captain.
Brand him, then Command him to Initiate as a bodyguard of a Warchief you have not Branded and finish the Uruk Mission.
Command him to Betray his Warchief and help him kill that Warchief, watching out for other bodyguards.
Kill the new Warchief yourself.

achievements.description: Slay the Hammer, the first Black Captain.
achievements.summary: Kill the Hammer, the first Black Captain.

steps.text: Start the story mission The Black Captain by meeting Hirgon at the Outcast hideout.
Fight and kill the Hammer outside the Monument Gate, over in the @loc{East Garrison} area.

achievements.description: Perform an Execution on a flaming Berserker.
achievements.summary: Perform an Execution on a Berserker who is on fire.

guide.context: Epic runes can make this unreliable; remove them from your weapons if it will not trigger.

steps.text: Find a Berserker near a campfire. The campfire below the @loc{Black Road} Forge Tower works; Fast Travel there to reset the Uruks.
Build your combo, throw the Berserker through the fire, and immediately do a Combat Execution.
Easier: buy Storm of Urfael for 2,500 Mirian for 20 seconds of unlimited Combat Finishers, then throw him into the fire and finish him.

achievements.description: Use the Detonate ability to burn 50 uruks.
achievements.summary: Burn 50 Uruks with the Detonate ability.

guide.context: Detonate is a Tier 1 Wraith ability. Uruks only have to burn, not die.

steps.text: Shoot campfires and Grog Barrels with Uruks standing next to them.
Keep doing this until 50 Uruks have burned. It usually happens on its own.

achievements.description: Free 5 caragors from cages.
achievements.summary: Free 5 Caragors from cages.

steps.text: Shoot the gate of a Caragor cage, as found in @loc{Durthang} and elsewhere in Udûn, to free the Caragor.
Repeat until you have freed 5.

achievements.description: Make 20 uruks flee by dropping Morgai Fly nests.
achievements.summary: Scare off 20 Uruks by dropping Morgai Fly Nests above them.

steps.text: When you see a Morgai Fly Nest hanging above Uruks on a building or rope, shoot or cut it down so the Uruks flee.
Repeat until 20 Uruks have fled.

achievements.description: Attract caragors with bait 5 times.
achievements.summary: Attract Caragors with Caragor bait 5 times.

steps.text: Shoot the hanging beast torsos on buildings and ropes, which are common around @loc{Durthang}.
Each shot that brings in a Caragor counts; do it 5 times.

achievements.description: Issue a Death Threat, and then successfully kill the target.
achievements.summary: Issue a Death Threat on a captain or Warchief, then kill the target yourself.

guide.context: Death Threat is available in the Sea of Núrnen. You must deal the killing blow; Branding or Dominating the target does not count.

steps.text: Buy the Death Threat ability.
Dominate a Worm or captain (an already Branded one works).
Use Death Threat on a different captain or on a Warchief.
Find that target and kill him.

achievements.description: Capitalize on a Warchief's Fear.
achievements.summary: Kill a Warchief while he is retreating because of one of his Fears.

guide.context: Do not Brand or Dominate him. If no Warchief has a Fear, let a Branded captain become Warchief and use him.

steps.text: Use Worms to learn the Warchiefs' Fears, such as Morgai Flies, Caragors, Graugs or fire.
Lure the Warchief out and trigger his Fear so he retreats.
Kill him while he is running away.

achievements.description: Kill all 5 Warchiefs before any uruk take their place.
achievements.summary: Kill all 5 Warchiefs of Udûn before any Uruk replaces one.

guide.context: Do this in Udûn. Killing every bodyguard first helps. If the other four are dead when Mogg the Other Twin dies, it unlocks on his death.

steps.text: Get Intel on the five Udûn Warchiefs and kill every bodyguard you can find.
Kill the four Warchiefs other than Mogg, avoiding deaths.
Kill Mogg the Other Twin last in the story mission The Warchief.

achievements.description: Unlock 2 Bow Rune slots.
achievements.estTime: ~5 min once you have the Mirian
achievements.summary: Unlock the second Bow rune slot.

steps.text: Collect 60 Mirian from challenges and early missions, then buy the second Bow rune slot.

achievements.description: Unlock 4 Dagger Rune slots.
achievements.estTime: ~20 min once you have the Mirian
achievements.summary: Unlock the fourth Dagger rune slot.

guide.context: Challenges and Legend Missions give enough Mirian; the three slots cost 620 Mirian in total.

steps.text: Buy Dagger slots 2, 3 and 4 for 60, 180 and 380 Mirian.

achievements.description: Unlock 3 Sword Rune slots.
achievements.estTime: ~10 min once you have the Mirian
achievements.summary: Unlock the third Sword rune slot.

guide.context: The second slot costs 60 Mirian, so you need 240 Mirian in total.

steps.text: Buy the second Sword rune slot for 60 Mirian, then the third for 180 Mirian.

achievements.description: Brand all 5 Warchiefs.
achievements.summary: Brand all 5 Warchiefs of the Sea of Núrnen.

guide.context: Only the Núrnen Warchiefs count, not Udûn's. If you kill one, a Branded captain who replaces him counts.

steps.text: Get Intel on the five Núrnen Warchiefs.
Brand each one, or Brand the captain who takes the place of one you killed.

achievements.description: Acquire a level 25 Rune.
achievements.summary: Get a Level 25 Rune from a captain or Warchief.

guide.context: Uruks cap at Level 20. A Warchief adds 2, knowing his Strengths and Weaknesses adds 1, being your Revenge Target adds 1, and exploiting a Weakness or Fear in the kill adds 1. Epic Runes have no level, and a Death Threat kill gives one.

steps.text: Pick a captain with an exploitable Weakness or Fear and keep him unbranded.
Let him kill you and Advance Time so he reaches Level 20. Make him a Warchief by killing his Warchief's other bodyguards, then the Warchief.
Get Intel on his Strengths and Weaknesses.
Lure him out and kill him using a Weakness, or after his Fear triggers.

achievements.description: Slay the Tower.
achievements.summary: Kill the Tower in the story mission Lord of Mordor.

guide.context: Brand all five Núrnen Warchiefs first to open this mission.

steps.text: Start the mission at @loc{Watcher's Landing} and sail to Ered Glamhoth with your Branded Warchiefs. Their bodyguards stay behind.
Kill your arch nemesis, then search the Stronghold for the Tower.
Stealth Drain his avatars 3 times.
Find the Tower one more time and kill him.

achievements.description: Begin a new hunt with Torvin.
achievements.summary: Complete the first Lord of the Hunt mission and return to Torvin.

steps.text: Follow Torvin and Shadow Mount the Caragath.
At the Uruk camp, kill the 5 marked Uruk Hunters.
Return to Torvin.

achievements.description: Defeat all the Beastmaster Warchiefs.
achievements.summary: Defeat each of the 5 Beastmaster Warchiefs as you play the Lord of the Hunt DLC campaign.

guide.context: These are story missions, and the achievement unlocks with the last kill.

steps.text: Tûmhorn Beast Tamer (@loc{Cab-Gwanath Bluff}): Stealth Kill 5 marked Uruks on your Caragath without raising the Alarm, then kill him.
Zûgor Beast Butcher (@loc{Fort Morn}): hit 20 Uruk Archers with Projectile Vomit from a Wretched Graug, then kill him.
Ûgakûga Graug Rider (@loc{Núrnen Peninsula}): Bait 3 Ghûl Mounds and let the Ghûls kill 10 Uruks, then kill his Graug Stompy and him.
Ashgarn Smuggler (@loc{Fort Morn}): shoot the 10 Uruk Couriers, who come in groups of 3, 3 and 4, then kill him.
Shágflak Ghûl Keeper (@loc{Harad Basin} cave): use Branded Ghûls to hurt him, as he resists Combat Finishers and ranged attacks, and finish him at the ruins to the north.

achievements.description: Complete 25 Caragath Stealth Kills.
achievements.summary: Perform 25 Stealth Kills while riding a Caragath.

guide.context: Kills count across the whole campaign.

steps.text: Ride a Caragath through Uruk camps.
Use Stealth Kills from the Caragath until the counter reaches 25.

achievements.description: Use a Wretched Graug's Projectile Vomit on an Uruk Captain or Warchief.
achievements.summary: Hit an Uruk captain or Warchief with a Wretched Graug's Projectile Vomit.

guide.context: The hit does not need to kill. Vomiting drains your Graug's health, so eat Uruks to heal.

steps.text: Shadow Mount a Wretched Graug. In the Warchief mission No Rest For the Wretched, you are given one.
Spit Projectile Vomit at Zûgor Beast Butcher, or at any bodyguard with him.
In free roam, lure a Wretched Graug with its bait, mount it, and vomit on a captain you have already identified.

achievements.description: Kill a Graug by dispatching your Ghûls on him.
achievements.summary: Kill a Wretched Graug with the finishing blow from your Branded Ghûls' Dispatch.

guide.context: The Dispatch explosion must land the last hit.

steps.text: At the end of Hypocritical Oath, stun the Wretched Graug with two fully charged headshots.
Damage it until it is low, around a quarter to half health.
Command your Branded Ghûls to explode to kill it.

achievements.description: Bait 10 Ghûl mounds.
achievements.summary: Bait 10 Ghûl Mounds.

guide.context: Most progress comes from Matrons Rising and Stronghold Uprising.

steps.text: Shoot Ghûl Mounds with your bow to bait Ghûls.
In free roam, search around the Sea of Núrnen, ideally at night, until you have baited 10.

achievements.description: Have 20 Branded Ghûls at one time.
achievements.summary: Have 20 Branded Ghûls at the same time.

guide.context: The mission Hypocritical Oath makes this easy. If you miss it, restart the mission before it ends.

steps.text: Start Hypocritical Oath in @loc{Thang Talath}.
Use Wraith Burn to Brand Ghûls. Brand 45, then hold out against the horde.
Keep over 20 Branded Ghûls alive at the same time.

achievements.displayName: I Had To Put Him Down
achievements.description: Kill a Caragath with an Execution.
achievements.summary: Execute a Caragath while mounted on it.

steps.text: Shadow Mount a Caragath, or use the one you start on after the first mission.
Use Kill Mount to execute it.

achievements.displayName: The Flames Make It Go Faster
achievements.description: Activate the Blazing Steed.
achievements.summary: Activate the Blazing Steed ability.

steps.text: In the Hunter Legend Mission Beast Master at @loc{Fort Morn}, charge Blazing Steed by killing with your Caragath.
Use Blazing Steed and ignite Uruks to finish the mission.

achievements.description: Eat a captain with a Wretched Graug.
achievements.summary: Eat an Uruk captain while riding a Wretched Graug.

guide.context: A captain who hates Graugs can void the attempt. You cannot grab a downed Uruk, so wait for him to stand.

steps.text: Do this right after the vomit hit in No Rest For the Wretched, using Zûgor Beast Butcher or a bodyguard.
Grab and eat one captain with the Graug.

achievements.description: Catch a Ghûl Matron on fire during the Lord of the Hunt campaign.
achievements.summary: Ignite a Ghûl Matron while playing the Lord of the Hunt campaign.

guide.context: This only counts in the Lord of the Hunt campaign. If you pass it, back up your save file, restart the campaign from its menu, play to the mission Matrons Rising, then restore your saved copy.

steps.text: In the mission Matrons Rising, shoot Ghûl Mounds to bait Ghûls and wait for a Ghûl Matron.
Lure her to a campfire or Grog Barrel and Detonate it, or build combo and hit her with a Fire Arrow.
Other chances: the Warchief mission Stronghold Uprising, and the Hunter Legend Mission A Feast of Flesh, a 3:00 fight against endless Ghûls.

achievements.description: Have a dominated Caragath, Wretched Graug and Spitter Ghûl simultaneously.
achievements.summary: Control a Branded Caragath, a Branded Wretched Graug and a Branded Spitter Ghûl simultaneously.

guide.context: Play at night, when Ghûl Mounds are easiest to find. The Warchief mission Homewrecker also has all three.

steps.text: Lure and Shadow Mount a Wretched Graug first, using its bait.
Find and Brand some Caragaths.
Bait Ghûl Mounds, build your combo by shooting your beasts, and use Wraith Burn on the Ghûls until a Spitter Ghûl is Branded.

achievements.description: Complete all objectives in the Test of the Wild.
achievements.summary: Complete all objectives of the Test of the Wild trial.

guide.context: The objectives are: kill all 5 Warchiefs, kill all 20 captains (Branded ones do not count), earn 13,000 points, have 10 captains killed by Beasts, and finish within 40:00. At least 11,000 points are needed before the last kill.

steps.text: Start Test of the Wild from the Trials of War tab and quickly find Intel on a Warchief. Ûgakûga Graug Rider is a strong pick.
Brand him and Command him to Riot against each other Warchief in turn; use Wretched Graugs and Graug Bait to kill the bodyguards and captains.
Kill Zûgor Beast Butcher yourself with bow headshots early, because his explosive crossbow can kill your Branded Warchief.
After the Warchiefs are dead, Riot your Branded Warchief against each remaining captain and kill them, with 10 killed by Beasts.
Dispatch Grunts after each riot for points, keep your Warchief alive, and kill him last. Finish within 40:00.
Jumping obstacles on a Caragath gives a speed boost and also pauses the timer.

achievements.description: The One Ring returns to its maker.
achievements.summary: Defeat Sauron in the final Bright Lord mission.

guide.context: Starting The True Lord of the Rings locks you out of the rest of this DLC campaign, so finish the other DLC achievements first or restart the campaign.

steps.text: Brand the five Udûn Warchiefs through their missions: Akoth the Vile (Branded Uruks kill 50 enemies within 4:00), Rûg the Crafty (rescue 5 captured Branded Uruks in Uruk's Hollow), Skak Raid Leader (Brand 10 marked Uruks without raising the Alarm), and Tûmhorn Evil Eye with Gorfel the Massive (rescue your 3 captured Warchiefs and hold out for 2:00).
Start The True Lord of the Rings at @loc{Uruk's Hollow}.
Fight Sauron, using the One Ring for 20 seconds of unlimited Combat Finishers.
Kill him; he revives your Warchiefs, and a second full One Ring charge lets you finish him directly.

achievements.description: Challenge the Dark Lord in Mordor.
achievements.summary: Complete the first Bright Lord mission to challenge the Dark Lord.

steps.text: Launch The Bright Lord via the main menu's Play tab.
Defeat the first 10 Uruks, then Brand 12 Uruks to take the @loc{Barrows of Udûn}.
Kill or Dominate Thrakrak Black-Thorn.

achievements.description: Shadow Brand 20 Uruks.
achievements.summary: Brand 20 Uruks with Shadow Brand.

guide.context: Shadow Brand is learned in the first DLC mission. Drain Branded Uruks to refill arrows.

steps.text: Aim the bow at an Uruk and use Shadow Brand to Brand him.
Repeat during the campaign until 20 Uruks are Branded this way.

achievements.description: Wraith Flash Dominate 50 Uruks.
achievements.summary: Dominate 50 Uruks with Wraith Flash.

guide.context: Progress builds up over the campaign, and you can finish it while chasing The Silver Fist.

steps.text: Fight a group of Uruks and build a high combo.
Use Wraith Flash to Dominate Uruks, ideally with your Branded Uruks attacking to keep the combo up.
Repeat until 50 Uruks have been dominated this way.

achievements.description: Maximize the power of the Ring by completing all of the One Ring missions.
achievements.summary: Complete all four One Ring Missions.

guide.context: They unlock after all four Forge Towers are built. Finish them before the last Bright Lord mission, which you cannot return from.

steps.text: Silver Persuasion (@loc{Barrows of Udûn}): Brand 9 Uruk Archers within 2:00, then kill or Brand 13 Berserkers.
Strength In Numbers (@loc{Udûn Crossing}): hold the Forge Tower for 3:00. A Graug arrives near 1:00 and Shadow Mount Brands it.
Shoddy Construction (@loc{Udûn Crossing}): kill or Brand 7 marked Uruks, then Command Branded Uruks to destroy two Cranes.
Don't Shoot the Messenger (@loc{East Garrison}): Brand 10 fleeing Uruk Messengers, then destroy 7 marked Grog Barrel stacks within 2:00.

achievements.description: Stealth Brand a Captain.
achievements.summary: Stealth Brand an Uruk captain.

guide.context: The captain must be vulnerable to Stealth Finishers, and you must not be in combat.

steps.text: In Press the Advantage, keep over 10 Branded Uruks for 2:00.
With about 15 seconds left, flee to a high point or bushes so the fight ends.
Get above or behind the captain Mozfel Quick-Blades, who is always vulnerable, unseen.
Use Stealth Brand on him.

achievements.description: Brand 20 Uruks in 60 seconds.
achievements.summary: Brand 20 Uruks within 60 seconds.

steps.text: Best place: the Forge Tower mission Press the Advantage in @loc{Southern Udûn Pass}, where Uruks keep spawning.
Let your Branded Uruks do the fighting to keep your combo up.
Use Wraith Flash Dominate on many Uruks to get 20 within 60 seconds.
If you miss it, sound the Alarm at any Stronghold for a fresh supply of Uruks.

achievements.description: Build all the Forge Towers in Udun.
achievements.summary: Complete all four Forge Tower missions in the Bright Lord campaign.

guide.context: Once you start the last Bright Lord mission, The True Lord of the Rings, you cannot go back. Finish this and the other DLC achievements first, or restart the DLC campaign.

steps.text: Barrows of Udûn: win the first mission by beating Thrakrak Black-Thorn.
Durthang Wastes, Petty Minds: Brand 15 Uruks without being detected, then kill or Brand Snagog the Diseased.
Black Road, Tools For the Task: defend a Trebuchet while Branding 7 Uruks, defend a Battering Ram while Branding 7 more, defend both for 2:00 and kill Bûbol the Gentle.
Southern Udûn Pass, Press the Advantage: Brand 15 Uruks, keep over 10 Branded for 2:00 and beat the captain who arrives.

achievements.description: Get a Level 30 Rune in Test of the Ring.
achievements.summary: Earn a Level 30 Rune while playing Test of the Ring.

guide.context: Uruks start at Level 25 here. A Warchief adds 2, Intel adds 1, a Revenge Target adds 1 and exploiting a Fear or Weakness adds 1. Trigger the Fear before the kill, or the rune is Level 24. A Death Threat kill gives an Epic Rune.

steps.text: Gather Intel on a Warchief, ideally Skak Raid Leader (hates Caragors) or Rûg the Crafty (hates Morgai Flies).
Let him kill you once so he becomes your Revenge Target.
Kill his bodyguards, lure him out and trigger his Fear.
Kill him after the Fear triggers.
If no Warchief has a usable Fear, kill the starting Warchiefs and Advance Time until a captain with one replaces a Warchief.
steps.note: Branded Uruks cannot be Commanded here.

achievements.description: Complete all objectives in the Test of The Ring.
achievements.summary: Complete all objectives of the Test of the Ring trial.

guide.context: Requirements: all 5 Warchiefs dead, 12 captains dead, 50 Uruk Grunts Branded, 8 captains or Warchiefs Branded, and the clock under 60:00. Branded captains may die later and still count.

steps.text: Start Test of the Ring from the Trials of War tab.
Find Worms or captains to Dominate for Intel and kill the 5 Warchiefs first. Do not Brand them.
Keep the One Ring charged by Branding Grunts, and use it on Warchiefs.
Kill or Brand the remaining captains. Look for missions that hold two captains, and avoid dying.
Brand 8 captains or Warchiefs and 50 Grunts during the run, then finish within 60:00.
Pausing the game stops the timer.
